restoration_note: This teaching describes how the Living Spirit (the Lord's operative power) addressed the three malformations of selfhood — water-deceit, darkness-deceit, fire-deceit — by putting on three garments (wind, water, fire) and stripping each in its proper season, like a physician treating compounded diseases. The body of the chapter expands into Twelve Works giving the providential reasons for this staged binding. Most editor proposals are confirmed by the surrounding formulae and standardized vocabulary (ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲗⲟⲡⲉ, ⲡⲡⲛⲁ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄, ⲍⲃⲥⲱ, ⲙⲁⲛⲝⲗⲟⲣⲉ, ⲡⲥⲁⲃⲧ, ⲙⲛⲧⲥⲛⲁⲩⲥ ⲛⲍⲱⲃ). Letter-completions and orthographic restorations are nearly all high-confidence. The very damaged middle of the page (sections 2533–2548) and the closing column (sections 2568–2585) preserve too little for confident restoration; large lacunae there are marked unrestorable.
